full_judgment: 19. D.W.1 Lal Banoo (defendant No. 1) stated that her mother Korfulnessa got land by gift from her father Khadem and that her mother Korfulnessa made a gift of that land to her. She stated that she paid rents and the receipts have been filed by her in Court.We find that the six rent receipts Ext. B-B(5) are provisional rent receipts showing payment of rent for 1.16 acre of land of khatian No.48 of Mouza Jatrabari by defendant No. 1 Lal Banoo and her husband defendant No. 20 Amjad Ali for the period from 1362 B.S. to 1372 B.S. It is significant to note that the contesting defendant appellants failed to produce any rent receipt whatsoever for any period before 1362 B.S. From the six provisional rent receipts Ext. B-Ext. B(5) no presumption of possession can be made.
